meta.title: Android compatibility fixes
meta.description: The Android/Termux compatibility fixes for DSH as a switchable plugin: flock session-lock degradation, session-log and attachment hardlink compatibility, app-boot native addon compatibility, and Enter-as-newline (five runtime-toggleable file patches), plus compile target, --allow-scripts, sharp wasm fallback, dsh wrapper, and the node-gyp NDK path (five install-time fact checks).
